subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with right to education?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 21A**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 21A of the Constitution of India deals with the right to education: 
 
• Article 21A guarantees the right to free and compulsory education for children between the ages of 6 and 14.
 
• It's a fundamental right that cannot be waived off. 
 
• Article 21A ensures that: 
 
 
• Education is basic and elementary, not religious or specialized 
 
• There's no discrimination and equal opportunities for education 
 
• The state provides adequate infrastructure, facilities, and qualified teachers 
 
 
 
• The responsibility for implementing Article 21A lies with the state governments. 
 
• Article 21A was introduced by the 86th Amendment Act of 2002. 
 
• Related act
 
 
• The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act (RTE) of 2009 describes the modalities of Article 21A.
 
• The RTE Act includes provisions such as: 
 
 
• Ensuring a specified pupil-teacher ratio 
 
• Prohibiting the deployment of teachers for non-educational work 
 
• Prohibiting physical punishment and mental harassment 
 
• Prohibiting capitation fees 
 
• Prohibiting private tuition by teachers 
 
• Prohibiting running schools without recognition
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Articles 18, 19, and 22 are all fundamental rights in the Indian Constitution:
 
• Article 18: Abolishes titles
 
• Article 19: Protects certain rights regarding freedom of speech
 
• Article 22: Protects against arrest and detention in certain cases
